----

This template is used to add extra newlines to adjust page breaks in [[:Image:Lojban_by_Choice_LojbanPod_Lessons.pdf]]. Please make sure that you know very well what you are doing when you modify this template! In particular, make sure that the <nowiki><noinclude></nowiki> tag is in the first line except for short periods of time when you generate a PDF.

The work flow to generate a PDF is this:
#move the <nowiki><noinclude></nowiki> tag in {{tl|SbcNewline}} to the second line
#uncomment the table of conents with page numbers in the [[Lojban_by_Choice/LojbanPod_lessons/Print_version]] and comment out the table of contents without page numbers
#generate a PDF from the Print version [[Lojban_by_Choice/LojbanPod_lessons/Print_version]], for example with the PDF printing of FireFox on MacOS X (letter format, centered page number)
#adjust the {{tl|SbcNewline}} templates in the lessons to ensure nice page breaks
#iterate the PDF generation and the adjustment of the {{tl|SbcNewline}} templates until you are satisfied (don't be too pedantic but at least avoid page breaks after section headings)
#correct the page numbers in the table of contents and generate the PDF once more
#postprocess the PDF (compression, web preview) and upload the PDF to Wikibooks
#comment out the table of contents with page numbers in the [[Lojban_by_Choice/LojbanPod_lessons/Print_version]] and uncomment the table of contents without page numbers
#move the <nowiki><noinclude></nowiki> tag in {{tl|SbcNewline}} to the first line
[[Category:Lojban by Choice/Templates|Newline]]
</noinclude>
